title: 1981. Minimize the Difference Between Target and Chosen Elements

examples.explanation: One possible choice is to: - Choose 1 from the first row. - Choose 5 from the second row. - Choose 7 from the third row. The sum of the chosen elements is 13, which equals the target, so the absolute difference is 0.
The best possible choice is to: - Choose 1 from the first row. - Choose 2 from the second row. - Choose 3 from the third row. The sum of the chosen elements is 6, and the absolute difference is 94.
The best choice is to choose 7 from the first row. The absolute difference is 1.
